# Experiment E1 of docs/spec/text-component.md, section 8.7: chat and the plain string of the client.
# Source: the log of the vanilla client. Each "[CHAT]" line is one message that the client shows in chat.
# A tellraw command resolves a selector, a score and an nbt content on the server before it sends the text.
# Thus the cases of these contents are in e4-server-string.txt. They go through an item name instead.
# The player is the offline test player Recorder. The vanilla client of the project version joined the vanilla server
# on 127.0.0.1. The server ran in offline mode. The console of the server gave each command.
# Each case has a header line with the id, the line of the command, and the log lines that the case wrote.
# A line that starts with "C " is a line of the client log. A line that starts with "S " is a line of the server log.
# A command with no output line wrote nothing in that log. The text after "[CHAT] " is the plain string that the process makes.
#
# case DSP001-a
> tellraw Recorder {text:"A",extra:[{text:"B",extra:[{text:"C"}]},{text:"D"}]}
C [01:43:55] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] ABCD
# case DSP001-b
> tellraw Recorder {translate:"[%s]",with:["x"],extra:["Y"]}
C [01:43:55] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] [x]Y
# case DSP001-c
> tellraw Recorder {translate:"%s|%s",with:[{text:"a",extra:["b"]},"c"],extra:["d"]}
C [01:43:56] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] ab|cd
# case DSP001-d
> tellraw Recorder {text:"",extra:["z"]}
C [01:43:56] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] z
# case DSP001-e
> tellraw Recorder {keybind:"key.jump",extra:[" after"]}
C [01:43:57] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] Space after
# case DSP001-f
> tellraw Recorder {selector:"@e[type=cow]",extra:["!"]}
C [01:43:57] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] Cow, Cow, Cow, Cow, Cow, Cow, Cow, Cow, Cow, Cow, Cow!
# case DSP001-g
> tellraw Recorder {translate:"a%sb",with:[{translate:"c%sd",with:["X"],extra:["e"]}],extra:["f"]}
C [01:43:58] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] acXdebf
# case DSP002-a
> tellraw Recorder {text:"  two  spaces  "}
C [01:43:58] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT]   two  spaces  
# case DSP002-b
> tellraw Recorder {text:"a%sb%%c%1$s"}
C [01:43:59] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] a%sb%%c%1$s
# case TPL-plain
> tellraw Recorder {text:"T1 plain"}
C [01:43:59] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] T1 plain
# case TPL-two-args
> tellraw Recorder {translate:"<%s> %s",with:["A","B"]}
C [01:44:00] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] <A> B
# case TPL-no-key
> tellraw Recorder {translate:"no.such.key"}
C [01:44:00] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] no.such.key
# case TPL-fallback
> tellraw Recorder {translate:"no.such.key",fallback:"fb %s!",with:["X"]}
C [01:44:01] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] fb X!
# case TPL-table-over-fallback
> tellraw Recorder {translate:"gui.yes",fallback:"fb"}
C [01:44:01] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] Yes
# case TPL-table-args

C [01:44:02] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] <P> hi
# case TPL-numbered

# case TPL-percent

# case TPL-err-d

# case TPL-err-end

# case TPL-err-zero
